_comment: === CLEAN COMPARISON INSTANCE for legacy vs event-based formulation ===
2 aircraft, 6 flights over 3 days, generous A-check threshold (1500 min)
vs. per-flight duration (200 min) and ample initial margin (0 min used),
so a legally feasible schedule with periodic maintenance exists under
BOTH the day-indexed legacy model and the event-based exact-state model.
Both aircraft start at maintenance-capable airport M.
